Standard Terms & Conditions
1. Settlement Terms: Net 30 days from invoice date. Electronic funds transfer to the designated bank accounts.
2. Late Interest: Overdue balances attract default interest at 1.5% per calendar month after the due date.
3. Retention of Title: Ownership of all delivered goods remains with Kestrel Industrial Supply until payment in full.
4. Inspection Period: Any damage or discrepancy must be notified in writing within 7 calendar days of site delivery.
5. Equipment Warranties: Standard original manufacturer warranties apply; installation workmanship is warranted for 12 months.
6. Arbitration & Jurisdiction: Disputes shall be settled under the Arbitration and Mediation Act in Lagos, Nigeria.
